name: Pokemon TCG: Battle Academy 2024
extCardText:
Join the Pokémon Trainers at the Battle Academy! Prepare for a Pokémon battle with the read-to-play Pokémon Trading Card Game Battle Academy! The Battle Academy includes everything two players need to play, with guides to the decks so your first game is easy to follow.
Battle Academy box comes with a two-player game board, three 60-card decks featuring Pikachu ex, Armarouge ex and Darkrai ex, tutorial guides, and gameplay accessories.

The Pokémon TCG Battle Academy includes:
• 3 complete Pokémon TCG decks (60 cards each)
• Each deck includes a powerful special Pokémon: Pikachu ex, Armarouge ex and Darkrai ex
• 2 tutorial guides to play right away
• 1 two-player game board
• 3 deck boxes to keep the cards organized
• 1 rulebook
• 1 large metallic coin
• 1 set of damage counters
• A code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online
